statement.p: The following statements are about the chromatic number \chi(G) and the chromatic index \chi'(G) of graphs. We use \Delta(G) for the maximum degree of G.
Are the following statements true or false?

li.p: If a every vertex of a graph has degree at most 7, then the chromatic index of the graph is at least 7.
For any cycle, the chromatic index is equal to the chromatic number.
